unit.why: A legend about the pre-Hasidic kabbalist R. Shimshon of Ostropol, saved on the Sabbath in the desert by a lion, with a short closing frame in which the Kotzker rebbe comments on it.

stories.start_quote: שמעתי מעשה מהרב הק׳ ר׳ שמשון מאסטריפאליע
stories.end_quote: מן הטבע מותר לסמוך על הנס
stories.summary_en: R. Shimshon of Ostropol pays a caravan owner not to travel on the Sabbath, but the owner takes the money and leaves him alone in the desert; a lion guards him through the Sabbath and afterwards carries him back to the caravan, and the Kotzker later explains that one who serves God above nature may rely on miracles.
